name: SDD harness: issue delivery
description: Business workflow skeleton for a specification-driven development harness: issue intake, bounded design slice, implementation, tests, review, and merge gate. Roles are business roles and connector systems are metadata only; the workflow does not mutate GitHub or merge code.

documents.name: SDD issue intake instruction
documents.content: Read the issue and define a bounded delivery slice. Return issue_summary, acceptance_criteria, out_of_scope, risk_notes, and next_action. Do not assign named agents; use business roles.

documents.name: SDD design slice instruction
documents.content: Turn the bounded issue slice into an implementation design. Return target_files, behavior_contract, tests_to_add, rollback_notes, and open_questions.

documents.name: SDD implementation instruction
documents.content: Implement only the approved slice. Return changed_files, commit_summary, assumptions, and remaining_risks.

documents.name: SDD test execution instruction
documents.content: Run the relevant checks for the implementation slice. Return tests_passed:boolean, checks:string[], failed_checks:string[], failure_summary:string|null, and evidence.

documents.name: SDD review instruction
documents.content: Review the slice for correctness, scope discipline, test evidence, and production risk. Return approved:boolean, findings, required_changes, and review_summary.

documents.name: SDD merge gate instruction
documents.content: Verify branch, commit, checks, review status, and remaining risks. Return merge_ready:boolean, required_operator_action, and final_report.

documents.name: SDD rework instruction
documents.content: Address failing checks or required review changes without expanding scope. Return fix_summary, changed_files, tests_to_rerun, and unresolved_risks.

elements.label: Merge gate ready for operator decision
